source: Local PowerView working tree supplied 16 September 2026
method: Baseline JavaScript executed with simulated DOM, IPC and gateway responses; no Electron or hardware validation.

results.name: HTTP failure now preserves remembered position
results.observation: Prior failed-command state finding is fixed.

results.name: Acknowledgment still replaces reported position before telemetry
results.observation: 25% opening becomes 90% on HTTP acknowledgment alone.

results.name: Single-axis update still transmits secondary
results.observation: Secondary is retained rather than reset, but is still sent unnecessarily.

results.name: The 25% preset sends 75% closed
results.observation: Preset labels use the opposite percentage convention from the number field.

results.name: Gen 3 scene route has been corrected

results.name: Transport error invokes bulk callback twice
results.observation: Both error and loadend deliver the callback.

results.name: Manual refresh on room grid does not refresh rooms or scenes
results.observation: Refresh requests only colors and shades until another navigation action.

results.name: Navigation away does not invalidate pending room reads
results.observation: A late room response can reopen the room after switching to Scenes.

results.name: Room names now render as text
results.observation: Prior room-heading HTML injection finding is fixed.

results.name: Type 9 still receives the single shade control
results.observation: Only type 8 gets the dual-rail graphic.
